subject.title: feat(gateway): auto-approve trusted-proxy browser device pairing

question: Should OpenClaw support trusted-proxy identity plus `allowUsers` as a documented replacement for manual first-time browser-device pairing, with persistent non-admin device grants?
rationale: This is a durable gateway trust-boundary and operator-policy decision, not a mechanical correctness question; tests can verify scope capping but cannot choose the supported security model.

options.title: Approve the bounded trust model
options.body: Accept proxy-authenticated allowlisted identities as an opt-in first-time browser pairing boundary, retaining the default-disabled setting and manual existing-device upgrades.

options.title: Keep manual device pairing
options.body: Do not merge the automatic approval mode and continue requiring an out-of-band operator approval for every new browser device.

options.title: Narrow the feature first
options.body: Require a more constrained design before acceptance, such as an additional deployment prerequisite or a non-persistent browser authorization path.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded trust model
recommendation.body: Accept proxy-authenticated allowlisted identities as an opt-in first-time browser pairing boundary, retaining the default-disabled setting and manual existing-device upgrades.
